paper.title: Wind Farm Layout Optimization with Multi-Type Wind Turbines for Minimizing Levelized Cost of Energy
paper.authors: Tian Li and Baoshan Yang and Qingshan Yang and Mingming Zhang and Weicheng Hu and Kunpeng Guo

authority_ladder: pinned cited-lineage public NREL turbine arrays

source_search.result: No target implementation, CFD input arrays, turbine-curve archive, random state, seed, repeat ledger or numeric result archive was found.

semantic_contract.site: 5 km by 5 km square divided into 10 by 10 cells; every cell center is a candidate
semantic_contract.encoding: 100 categorical genes: zero empty, one NREL 5 MW, two IEA/NREL 15 MW
semantic_contract.turbines: 5 MW: hub 90 m, rotor radius 63 m, life 20 y; 15 MW: hub 150 m, rotor radius 120 m, life 20 y
semantic_contract.inflow: steady 12 m/s at 150 m, flow direction selected per case, power-law exponent 0.12 and Iref 0.12
semantic_contract.wake: paper-corrected three-dimensional Qian-Ishihara velocity and turbulence model, linear velocity deficit and modified overlap-aware turbulence superposition
semantic_contract.fatigue: paper Eq.55 with maintenance compensation 0.5 and turbulence fatigue coefficient 0.7
semantic_contract.cost: paper Eqs.30-39, 40 half-year preventive cycles, preventive reduction 0.8, preventive cost 0.01 percent and replacement cost 5 percent of turbine price
semantic_contract.objective: minimize scalar LCOE equal to construction plus maintenance cost divided by steady total power
semantic_contract.algorithm: roulette GA, single-point categorical crossover, category-balanced variable mutation
semantic_contract.formal_stopping: fixed 1000 generations because the paper states a maximum-iteration limit but publishes no numeric convergence tolerance
semantic_contract.physical_fes: one complete wake-fatigue-LCOE evaluation of one 100-cell layout
